Interface DataProvider

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable, Closeable
All Known Subinterfaces:
Datastore, RewritableDatastore
public interface DataProvider extends Closeable
Read-only access to multi-dimensional image data.

    • getAxisLength

      @Deprecated int getAxisLength(String axis)
      Deprecated.
      Use getNextIndex(String) instead.
      Returns the highest index plus 1 along the given axis. If the axis is not (yet) represented in the data set, it will return 0.

      If the axis is present in the data set, but no Coords with that axes are found (Coords for an axis can not be zero), it will return 1.

      Missing images for any given axis are ignored, e.g. if the DataProvider has images 0, 1, 3, 4 for a given axis, it will return 5. Do not expect all images along a given axis to be present in the DataProvider.

      Parameters:
      axis - Axis for which the next index is requested.
      Returns:
      Next Index for the given axis.

    • getNextIndex

      int getNextIndex(String axis)
      Returns the highest index along the given axis plus 1. If the axis is not (yet) represented in the data set, it will return 0.

      If the axis is present in the data set, but no Coords with that axes are found (Coords for an axis can not be zero), it will return 1.

      Missing images for any given axis are ignored, e.g. if the DataProvider has images 0, 1, 3, 4 for a given axis, it will return 5. Do not expect all images along a given axis to be present in the DataProvider.

      Parameters:
      axis - Axis for which the next index is requested.
      Returns:
      Next Index for the given axis.

    • getImagesIgnoringAxes

      List<Image> getImagesIgnoringAxes(Coords coords, String... ignoreTheseAxes) throws IOException
      Returns a list of image in the DataProvider's collection that have identical coords after removing the given axes from both source and target.
      Parameters:
      coords - Coords to look for in the provider's collection
      ignoreTheseAxes - Axes that will be removed from copy of Coords in the collection before checking for identity
      Returns:
      images in the dataProvider's collection with the desired Coords
      Throws:
      IOException - when error occurs loading the data from storage
